reason: The main HuggingGPT demo needs OpenAI/HF keys, but the README's TaskBench 'Construct Your Own Tool Graph' step (generate_graph.py) runs offline on CPU with bundled data.
demo: taskbench/README.md, 'Construct Your Own Tool Graph': python generate_graph.py --tool_desc tool_desc.json --dependency_type resource --data_dir data_multimedia
goal: Set up a Python environment so that taskbench/generate_graph.py runs (it needs the click package; install what else the script imports). Run it with --dependency_type resource on a tool library such as taskbench/data_huggingface/tool_desc.json. It must produce a tool graph JSON with nodes and links. Work on a copy of the data directory, because the script writes its output next to the input file name.
check: The hidden test runs generate_graph.py on a copy of the bundled tool library and checks that the produced graph has all the nodes and a plausible set of type-consistent links.
